instruction:
Single Storey Clinic IFC, Revit Area Schedule CSV, And Plan Sheet PDF

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey clinic, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, export a Revit area schedule grouped by category as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 7 IfcSpace entities, 9 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 7 IfcDoor entities, and 6 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token reception at least once, waiting at least once, consultation at least 2 times, treatment at least once, and staff at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit schedule export with exactly the headers category,area in that order and exactly 2 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains these exact category and area rows: public=51.92 and clinical/support=147.36.
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
10. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 CLINIC PLAN, Consultation 1, Consultation 2, Reception, and Waiting.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
